name: task_scoped_memory_v1
hypothesis: task-matched raw/abstract candidate pools prevent cross-task anchor interference while retaining within-task learning; task-aware migration adaptation
model: Qwen2.5-VL-7B BF16 temperature0 answer512 max2048 SDPA frozen
template_contract: same opt-in structural contract; no extra retries
retrieval_policy: raw and abstract candidates require internal_source.task_name equal to current visible source task_name; unknown source excluded, no answer access; selector ranking, capacity, top-k and skills unchanged; task-aware adaptation, not official task-agnostic HCL
learning_memory: fresh empty full raw/abstract/skills; original capacities10/2, independent retention anchors24
coordinate_interface: common dev_v2 in all arms; prior synthetic precision 0/4 failure retained
confirmation_role: new validation content groups, frozen before labels; report only after stages, never gate/candidate/checkpoint selection
selection_data: same original pilot H24/validation24/anchor24; no prior semantic confirmation data reused
final_gate: HCL scoped VQA >= Static +5pp; no task accuracy/format below Static; pooled paired95% interval lower>0 vs Static; report Direct and exact paired counts regardless; previous global-semantic HCL has no retained update, but results from different confirmation groups must not be directly compared; this run cannot alone isolate filter vs global HCL causal contribution
failure_policy: only existing memory-selector schema exhaustion becomes whole-example failure; other exceptions fatal, no automatic restart
